June 14, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Darsana Capital Partners Lp decreased Netflix Inc (NFLX) stake by 31.25% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Darsana Capital Partners Lp sold 250,000 shares as Netflix Inc (NFLX)’s stock rose 19.42%. The Darsana Capital Partners Lp holds 550,000 shares with $162.44 million value, down from 800,000 last quarter. Netflix Inc now has $169.53B valuation. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 115.45% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 102.88% the S&P500.
